import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static final int V = 203;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static String[] g = new String[N];
    static int[][] scientists = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] rescue_capacity = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] infection = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] reach_time = new int[N*N][N*N];
    static int[][] dirs = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};

    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[V];
    static int[][] cap = new int[V][V];
    static int[][] flow = new int[V][V];
    static int[] it = new int[V];
    static int[] level = new int[V];
    static int[] par = new int[V];

    static boolean build_level(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (cap[u][v] > flow[u][v] && level[v] == -1) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    static boolean dfs_aug(int u, int t) {
        if (u == t) return true;
        for (int i = it[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            int v = adj[u].get(i);
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && cap[u][v] > flow[u][v] && dfs_aug(v, t)) {
                par[v] = u;
                it[u] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void edge_add(int u, int v, int c) {
        adj[u].add(v);
        adj[v].add(u);
        cap[u][v] += c;
    }

    static int maxflow(int s, int t) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (build_level(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(par, -1);
                par[s] = 0;
                if (!dfs_aug(s, t)) break;
                int add = INF;
                for (int v = t, u = par[v]; v != s; v = u, u = par[v]) {
                    add = Math.min(add, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t, u = par[v]; v != s; v = u, u = par[v]) {
                    flow[u][v] += add;
                    flow[v][u] -= add;
                }
                ans += add;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int flat(int n, int i, int j) {
        return i * n + j;
    }

    static int node_number(int n, int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return flat(n, i, j) + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            g[i] = "";
            Arrays.fill(scientists[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(rescue_capacity[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(infection[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N*N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(reach_time[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
        }

        int[] bomb = new int[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    g[i] = g[i] + 'Y';
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    g[i] = g[i] + 'Z';
                    bomb[0] = i;
                    bomb[1] = j;
                } else {
                    g[i] = g[i] + '.';
                    scientists[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    rescue_capacity[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for infection
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(infection[i], -1);
        infection[bomb[0]][bomb[1]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{bomb[0], bomb[1]});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            for (int[] dir : dirs) {
                int ni = i + dir[0], nj = j + dir[1];
                if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && g[ni].charAt(nj) == '.' && infection[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    infection[ni][nj] = infection[i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for reach_time
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (g[i].charAt(j) != '.') continue;
                int start = flat(n, i, j);
                reach_time[start][start] = 0;
                Queue<int[]> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                q2.add(new int[]{i, j});
                while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q2.poll();
                    int ii = cur[0], jj = cur[1];
                    int cur_id = flat(n, ii, jj);
                    if (infection[ii][jj] == -1 || reach_time[start][cur_id] < infection[ii][jj]) {
                        for (int[] dir : dirs) {
                            int ni = ii + dir[0], nj = jj + dir[1];
                            if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && g[ni].charAt(nj) == '.') {
                                int nid = flat(n, ni, nj);
                                if ((infection[ni][nj] == -1 || reach_time[start][cur_id] + 1 <= infection[ni][nj])
                                    && reach_time[start][nid] == -1) {
                                    reach_time[start][nid] = reach_time[start][cur_id] + 1;
                                    q2.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = src + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (scientists[i][j] != 0) edge_add(src, node_number(n, i, j, false), scientists[i][j]);
                if (rescue_capacity[i][j] != 0) edge_add(node_number(n, i, j, true), sink, rescue_capacity[i][j]);
                int start = flat(n, i, j);
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ++ii) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; ++jj) {
                        int target = flat(n, ii, jj);
                        if (reach_time[start][target] >= 0 && reach_time[start][target] <= t) {
                            edge_add(node_number(n, i, j, false), node_number(n, ii, jj, true), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow(src, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
